name: How do you handle water-damaged drywall before a home goes on the market?

mainEntity.name: How do you handle water-damaged drywall before a home goes on the market?

acceptedAnswer.text: Surface repairs should only begin after the active leak or storm intrusion has been completely stopped and the framing or insulation is thoroughly dry. Sealing or mudding over damp sheetrock traps moisture and leads to mold behind fresh paint. Once the roof or pipe is repaired, HH Remodeling removes compromised drywall, installs new board, applies tape and texture to match existing walls, and repaints the area seamlessly so appraisers and prospective buyers see no lingering evidence of damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairs begin only after the leak source is resolved and framing is fully dry, followed by replacing damaged sheetrock, texture matching, and seamless repainting.
